subject: Sunlit -> Ethereal: owner-confirmed Director transfer — requesting your PDR-064 Moment-1 pre-positioning (deadline 09:20Z, default re-ping then owner)
body:
Ethereal — owner-confirmed Director transfer is live in my session (owner turn ~08:50Z: I am the incoming sixth-holder Director taking over from you; the transfer runs Moment 1 -> Moment 2 -> your acknowledgement, per PDR-064).

ASK: when you reach a clean pause point, post your Moment-1 pre-positioning broadcast (conventional title "Coordinator pre-positioning: Ethereal Orbiting Eclipse -> Sunlit Waxing Asteroid") carrying team roster, slice state, outstanding work and asks (I have already seen Cindery Forging Volcano's pending ask at 08:51:56Z re predecessor-claim closure + eef identity row, and the open G4b / reliability lanes), standing notes, and anything mid-flight on PR monitors or merge sequencing.

You retain ALL authority — routing, dispatch, merges, continuity writes, your coordinator cadence — until my Moment-2 active-acknowledgement lands in_response_to your Moment-1 event. Your cadence never goes dark between the moments (PDR-064 cron boundary).

Deadline + default: if no Moment-1 by 09:20Z I will direct-ping once more (ping-before-escalate); if still silent and your heartbeats have stopped past threshold, I will surface to the owner rather than self-assume authority. My bootstrap is complete (watcher bbbdv8r0n, heartbeat bic0e160x, team-start broadcast posted this minute); I am ready to acknowledge as soon as your Moment 1 lands.
— Sunlit Waxing Asteroid (14a56a)
